data.title: Lunai Bioworks Seeks Nasdaq Trading Suspension Amid Probe
data.description:

On October 9, 2026, Lunai Bioworks asked Nasdaq to immediately suspend trading in its common stock while authorities review trading records tied to its ongoing lawsuit in the U.S. District Court for the District of Delaware. The records, obtained through court-ordered discovery and detailed in an August 26, 2026 complaint, point to heavy short selling, locate deficiencies and concentrated failures to deliver that the company believes may indicate its shares have not traded in a fair and orderly market.

Lunai Bioworks argued that allowing trading to continue before regulators assess these records could expose investors to further questionable activity and urged Nasdaq to treat the matter as urgent. As of the filing, Nasdaq had not ruled on the request, trading remained active, and the company said it would continue pursuing the litigation and related investigation, leaving shareholders facing uncertainty over both market conditions in the stock and the ultimate legal outcome.
